name: agentistics-vscode
description: Your coding-assistant fleet and your usage metrics, inside the editor — a client of the local agentop server.

commands.title: Agentistics: Open the whole fleet in an editor tab
Agentistics: Open a session in a tab
Agentistics: Attach to a session in a terminal
Agentistics: Start the local agentop server

agentistics.apiUrl.markdownDescription: The local `agentop server` API — port 47291 by default. Everything the extension knows comes from here; it never reads `~/.agentistics` or talks to tmux itself.

agentistics.language.markdownDescription: Language for the extension and for the sentences the server sends back. `auto` follows VS Code's own display language and falls back to English.

agentistics.notifyOnAttention.description: Show a notification when a session starts waiting on you. Fired on the transition into that state, never on the level — a session that has been waiting for an hour does not re-announce itself.

agentistics.statusBar.description: Show today's cost and tokens in the status bar.

agentistics.statusBarRefreshSeconds.markdownDescription: How often to re-read today's totals. The fleet list refreshes every 5 seconds regardless — this timer is for `/api/data`, which is megabytes on a well-used machine, so it is deliberately slow.

agentistics.readProjections.markdownDescription: Read today's totals from the projections (`/api/runtime/metrics`, the journal): a few hundred bytes instead of the whole `/api/data`. On by default; turn it off to read `/api/data` instead. When the server serves no projections (`AGENTISTICS_PROJECTIONS` off, a central), the extension reads `/api/data` by itself. `AGENTISTICS_PROJECTIONS_SURFACES=legacy` in the editor's environment also turns it off.

agentistics.currency.markdownDescription: Currency for the status bar. `brl` converts with the live rate the server already fetches (`/api/rates`), through the same formatter the dashboard uses — so the two can never disagree about the same day.

scripts.build: bun run build:extension && bun run build:webview
